svg.title: Why OmniRoute — stop juggling 10 dashboards, dead API keys and surprise bills. Ten daily pains and how OmniRoute fixes each: subscription quota expiring unused — maximize subscriptions, track quota and use every token before reset. Rate limits stopping you mid-coding — 4-tier auto-fallback from Subscription to API to Cheap to Free in milliseconds. Tool outputs like git diff, grep and logs burning tokens — RTK + Caveman compression saves 15 to 95 percent of eligible tokens per request. Expensive APIs at 20 to 50 dollars per month per provider — cost-optimized routing to the cheapest viable model. Each AI tool wanting its own setup — one endpoint, every tool, one dashboard. AI blocked in your country — 3-level proxy plus TLS fingerprint stealth. Dead keys and banned accounts killing your flow — 3-layer resilience with circuit breakers, key cooldown and model lockout. One subscription shared by a whole team — key pools with fair-share quotas per member enforced in the hot path. Prompts routed through someone else's cloud — local-first, runs on your machine with AES-256-GCM encrypted keys. No idea where tokens and money go — live analytics with usage, quota, savings and p95 latency per provider.
svg.desc: Animated comparison ledger: ten pain-versus-fix rows are fully readable on the first frame; a soft highlight sweeps down the rows in a continuous cycle.
svg.text: Stop juggling 10 dashboards, dead API keys, and surprise bills.
